findings.title: Food-photo vision turn fails live; item 38 acceptance criterion unmet
findings.detail: ossctl chat selftest --fixture fried-chicken-leg.jpg on test_vision: the provider log shows images=1 (ACP image block sent, promptCapabilities.image advertised) but the answer said it could not analyze the image and gave no estimate (VERIFICATION FEAT-007 table; FEAT findings 'STILL OPEN'). CR3-IH-4 and the FEAT acceptance criterion 'a food photo returns an estimate' are not met, and there is no key/account cause under User action needed. The cause is unproven: block shape/MIME, the test_vision model (inherits test = claude-haiku-4.5) not taking images through Kiro, or Kiro dropping images for the ossbot-chat agent. Fix: isolate with a headless kiro-cli chat --v3 image prompt on roles.vision and a check of the block against the ACP ImageContent schema; fix and pass the live check (or record a key/account cause). Until then set DES-V-30 back to partial, because 'which catalog models accept images (the vision role)' is unanswered.

findings.title: No Hermes plugin tool call reaches the gatekeeper live; Kiro text tool bridge broken
findings.detail: VERIFICATION: no function_call reached the gatekeeper in any live turn and the model said ossbot_request_sandbox_job was unavailable. On the live system ~hermes/.hermes/ossbot-features/ does not exist (ossbot_feature_save never ran), while doctor shows the tool surface ok with the ossbot toolset enabled, so the tools are registered but lost between Hermes and Kiro (tools empty at _create_chat_completion, render_tool_bridge_sections output, the preamble steering to web tools, or <tool_call> blocks not parsed by extract_tool_calls_from_text). Every plugin tool (status, queue, notify, pause, kill, request_discovery, feature stores, code jobs) is unreachable in production; the F007-R1-2 fix is proven only hermetically. CR2-3f and CR2-7i read done on hermetic evidence. Fix: add a metadata-only provider log (tool definitions received, bridge sections rendered, tool_call blocks parsed), fix the bridge, pass one live plugin call and the live image code job, and keep CR2-3f/CR2-7i partial until then.

findings.title: GHMCP-1..4 (read-only GitHub MCP server) still not started
findings.detail: Carried from F007-R1-6. TRACEABILITY GHMCP-1..4 are still missing / not started. The owner decision of 2026-10-19 ('keep it simple') is recorded in the FEAT findings: pinned github-mcp-server v2.0.2 binary, 'stdio --read-only --toolsets repos,issues,pull_requests,actions', GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN from GITHUB_READ_TOKEN, scout/reviewer Kiro agents and Hermes, one startup check that fails closed on any non-read tool, doctor get_me == Amsal1, read-token sha256 in the output key scan. Verify at 2.32.0 that agent MCP env ${VAR} expansion needs cli.json kiroAgent.mcpApprovedEnvVars. Fix: implement as decided with the fake-listing allowlist and 'write tool listed -> fail closed' tests.

findings.title: Gatekeeper imports the root probe module ossbot.ctl.hermes_probe
findings.detail: gatekeeper/context.py, chat/backend.py and api/chat.py import the root ACP probe client to use read_result/relay_open. No import-linter contract bounds what the gatekeeper uses from it. Fix: move read_result/relay_open (and the result path) into ossbot.common, or add a contract.

findings.title: Streamed deltas and SSE lines not bounded in memory
findings.detail: ChatService.ask appends every response.output_text.delta and joins them when no response.completed arrives; only the stored text is capped (200 KiB), not memory, although the ADR addendum promises a 512 KiB per-answer bound. HermesClient._events checks MAX_EVENT only after aiter_lines buffered a whole line. Fix: stop accumulating at MAX_ANSWER and bound the line read.

findings.title: pytest-xdist not added (build-plan rule 9)
findings.detail: Rule 9 (f3ca1f8) runs the hermetic suite once per round with -n auto via pytest-xdist as a pinned dev dependency; pyproject.toml has pytest-timeout but no xdist, and the bar took 8 min 11 s serially. Fix: add pytest-xdist==<pinned>, uv lock, sync DEV/ROOTDEV.
